mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 8.0% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 8.0%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and industrial production indicate robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger demand and supply chain activity.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both HOUST and INDPRO rising) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals potential inflation-driven monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, a rise in CPIAUCSL (over the past month) does not lead to negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) reflects strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 700 thousand units indicate a recovering residential sector, which typically precedes broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 700, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) are rising and the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%), strong consumer demand combined with accommodative monetary policy drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS rising and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-recession recovery phase, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 95 signals improving manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-recession recovery regime, INDPRO above 95 does not lead to positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.
